field_candidates.value: Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Enhanced Senses, Self-Sustenance (Type 1; Can breathe in the vacuum of space Harley Quinn Vol 3 #67 ), Martial Arts (Is a professional wrestler capable of contesting other wrestlers), Acrobatics, Weapon Mastery (Harley has shown proficiency with all sorts of weapons, from assault rifles to plungers and toiletry's to large hammers and more), Multiple Personalities (Shown here and here), Fourth Wall Awareness (Is capable of reading the comics she's in Harley Quinn Vol 3 #64 as well as speaking to the reader directly on multiple occasionsHarley Quinn Vol 3 #70 ), Immortality Negation (Type 7; Can kill the Coney Island Zombies), Genius Intelligence (Extraordinary Genius), Chaos Manipulation, Order Manipulation (As the Angel of Retribution was stated to have the power of both the Lord of Chaos and the Lord of Order Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66), Reality Warping, Plot Manipulation (Wields the power of continuity stating that specific symbols will appear at the end of every comic and receiving notifications during crossover events, she is also the narrator for a large portion of her stories addressing the reader as "dreamers, hustlers, and schemers" Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66 Harley Quinn Vol 3 #71; Harley was capable of accidentally destroying all of DC Continuity to a greater degree than that of the Milk Wars Harley Quinn Vol 3 #50 ), possesses the red-black lantern ring, briefly the green lantern ring, and possesses the yellow lantern ring, Pain Manipulation, Memory Manipulation, Dimensional Travel, Portal Creation (As Hammer Harleen, her hammer contains a mother box which can torture one-thousand people at once, force her to focus on a single memory, as well as create boom-tubes allowing her to teleport from place to place), Indomitable Will (Was unphased after having 94-thousand different calculations on how to break her personality), Resistance to Madness Manipulation (Could look into Johnny Sorrows face which is stated to be the true face of madness), Plot Manipulation (Was unaffected by the final wave which wiped DC's Continuity),

Universe Level+ (Was capable of harming both the Lords of Chaos and Order whom are said to be as strong as the entire universe) | Outerverse Level (Was capable of knocking out Rebirth Hal Jordan who should be comparable to his Post-Crisis self; On multiple occasions can damage and combat the new god Granny Goodness, depowered she can also tank hits from her) | High Outerverse Level (Was capable of shattering DC's continuity which is stated to be the force keeping all of reality from spinning out of control and its stated that when Harley did this it was worse than The Milk Wars caused by the Retcon Corp, and afterwards sent waves across continuity strong enough to completely destroy DC's continuity as well as beings such as the Anti-Monitor)
MFTL+ likely Immeasurable Speed (Comparable in speed to Rebirth Hal Jordan) | Irrelevant Speed (Can exist and move at the end of continuity)
Star Level (Tanked having a sun thrown at her) | High Outerverse Level (Survived the final wave which destroyed all of DC's Continuity)

Batman is one of the most intelligent beings in the DC Universe and is the second most intelligent human alive, only behind Lex Luthor. The World Forger considers Batman one of the greatest strategic minds in existence. In her B:TAS key, Barbara boasts: * Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, and Durability) * Superhuman Athleticism (Performs inhumanly high leaps in her debut) * Hand-to-Hand Combat Skills (Even prior to training with Batman, she had been instructed in self-defense) * Acrobatics (Shown to be prodigious at acrobatics, casually doing incredible flips) With her BTAS key's Optional Equipment, she can utilize: * Smoke Manipulation (Used a smoke grenade against Two-Face's gang) In her TNBA key, Barbara now wields: * Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, and Durability) * Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) * Hand-to-Hand Combat Mastery (According to Batman: Animated (a book about the production of BTAS and TNBA written by the show's crew), has honed her “physical and deductive skills” to the point that they “all but rival (Batman’s).” Is playable in Rise of Sin Tzu - every single playable character in Rise of Sin Tzu is regarded by the game's manual as wielding "extraordinary martial arts abilities." Is an "accomplished martial artist." Takes on foes with “acrobatic fighting skills.” Stated to possess "combat training." Shown to know at least basic judo throws) * Enhanced Senses (Noticed Terry McGinnis was in her office despite him being invisible, and trained in stealth by Bruce Wayne - for reference, even a highly trained field member of the NSA had no idea Terry was there despite being just feet away from him. Was also trained by Bruce Wayne, and as such should have received the same training that granted Tim Drake inhumanly sharp hearing) * Weapon Mastery (with Gadgets such as Batarangs - in example, she can throw a Batarang accurately enough to disarm Mr. Freeze) * Vehicular Mastery (with the Batmobile and her Motorcycle, both of which she's shown driving with expertise) * Greater Acrobatics (Is now an olympic-level athlete. Avoided beams from Mr. Freeze's blaster with flips. Flipped to avoid energy beams. Easily traversed an airborne gymnastic course) * Greater Superhuman Athleticism (Has jumped absurdly far) * Paralysis Inducement (Can restrain foes with her Bola, Rope Batarangs, and these capsules which create a strong adhesive) * Electricity Manipulation (Uses an electrified Batarang) * Adhesive Manipulation (via Adhesive Pellets) * Light and Sound Manipulation (via Flashbangs) * Smoke Manipulation (via Smoke Pellets) * Explosion Manipulation (Shown to use an explosive) * Hacking (Can hack into the door system of a vault. Even better with technology than Batman and Nightwing) * Preparation (Prepared silicate powder specifically to take on Livewire) * Vehicular Mastery (with the Batmobile, seemingly) With her Optional Equipment, she can utilize: * Batmobile: Fire Manipulation and Smoke Manipulation (The Batmobile can shoot flame and fire smoke bombs) * Negation of Electricity (with Silicate Powder) Despite never demonstrating these, it is very likely that, due to studying under Batman, Batgirl possesses Stealth Mastery, Escapology Mastery, Disguise Mastery, et cetera. Due to being a close ally of Batman who has access to the Batcave, it stands to reason that her optional equipment could include all of Batman's equipment, as she could reasonably access it and use it in battle.

At least Wall Level (At least 17 Kilojoules - Can brawl with and knock out hardened criminals, some of them twice her size - said criminals should scale to (at least) the likes of Doctor Destiny, who outside of the Dreamscape is only an average, somewhat frail man), possibly higher physically (Made Robin slightly stagger back with a kick, though she did no real damage. Was similarly capable of knocking back Mr. Freeze with a kick, though she could seemingly only do so because she caught him off guard), higher cutting damage with Batarangs | Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Considering she is said to have spent the two-year timeskip between BTAS and TNBA "honing her physical abilities" in hopes of being a better vigilante, it seems only intuitive that she would have become substantially stronger. Fought Harley Quinn (who could harm Nightwing as well as Batman), one-sidedly beating her down. Struggled with Catwoman. Kicked TNBA era Clayface hard enough to warp his face and knock him over. In Rise of Sin Tzu, can fight and beat down the game's common enemies (kicking them into concrete hard enough to notably crater it and punching them through wooden fences), who, during one story mission, are shown to, over time and with several minutes of constant attack, wear down and damage the Batcave's thick metal security doors. Should be comparable to The Penguin's henchwomen, who could kick Batwoman through a concrete wall, making a large crater. Kicked a door down), possibly higher (Using the Batrope, was able to temporarily restrain Calendar Girl's mechanical dinosaur, which was powerful enough to smash apart rocky cliffsides just by headbutting them - though this is a pretty transparent outlier overall), higher cutting damage with Batarangs

Hypersonic (Scaling to Mach 8.7), possibly Relativistic+ (Scaling to 0.53c) reactions and combat speed, (Dodged a leg-sweep from Catwoman, and reacted to her whip swing, slashing her whip in two with a Batarang. Evaded tommy-gun fire), with Superhuman running speed (Briefly kept ahead of Dick Grayson) | Hypersonic combat speed and reactions (Scaling to Mach 8.7 - Should be at least slightly faster considering her two years of training with Batman. Stated to be faster than Nightwing in combat. Reacted to a bullet and moved around a lot during its flight. Shown to be as fast as Harley Quinn), possibly as high as Relativistic+ reactions and combat speed (Scaling to 0.53c - As mentioned earlier, slightly superior to Batman and Nightwing. Could cross several feet in the time it took Mr. Freeze's laser-powered cold gun's beam to fly a few meters toward her, and leapt over one of its blasts while it traveled toward her. Dealt with Livewire's lightning - in one instance moving to block a blast while it flew toward her before it could cross just a few feet - moving at Mach 502 to do so), with Subsonic travel speed with her Motorcycle (Should be as fast as IRL motorcycles) and at least Superhuman running speed (Shouldn’t be any slower than her prior key)

At least Wall Level, possibly higher (At least 17 Kilojoules - Scaling to her AP, as per Newton’s Third Law) | Small Building Level (Scaling to 0.095 Tons - Should be capable of withstanding the force of her own blows. Took a punch from Harley Quinn. Took a punch from Dora Smithy, whose strikes could warp metal bars)

Notable Attacks/Techniques: * Omega Effect: Uxas was reborn as Darkseid when he absorbed the full power of the Omega Effect from the Infinity Pit. Thanks to the Omega energies he gained incredible power and a wide array of abilities. * Omega Beams: Darkseid's signature technique involves firing a thin, red energy beam from each eye. These beams, also known as "Finder Beams", are extremely fast and home in on their target, passing through physical barriers if needed. Once contact is made, they can either erase the target from existence, a technique called the total wipeout, or transport them through time and space according to Darkseid's will. He can also use them to recreate dead beings, or paralyze his target while probing their weakness. * Omega Sanction: Also known as the Life Trap, the Omega Sanction can take two completely different forms depending on Darkseid's intent. The first simply sends his target back in time, forcing them to live out their life in the past. The second, stated by Grant Morrison to happen when Darkseid decides on being crueler than normal, was only displayed by Godhead Darkseid. It traps the victim in a never-ending series of horrible realities that force them to live out worse and worse lives, until their soul breaks. * Energy Absorption: Darkseid is an immensely powerful energy absorber, capable of completely draining the energies of powerful beings like Mordru and all of Sorcerers' World to help restore his own power. His absorption is so powerful that he ordered his servants to get away from him lest they be killed, and some of his servants were capable of taking on Pre-Crisis Kryptonians and Daxamites. * Energy Shockwaves: Darkseid can create shockwaves of energy by raising his hands. * Spacetime Warping: Darkseid can generate a gravitational pull so intense that space twists and time is pulled, so that those inside live days between seconds. * Boom Tubes: Darkseid can summon boom tubes at will, as well as control the paths of others' boom tubes. These portals can transport their user throughout space and between dimensions. They automatically adjust the size of their user to be suitable for their destination, which is why Darkseid appears human-sized rather than star-sized when travelling to the mortal universe. * Telepathy: Darkseid has incredibly powerful telepathic abilities. He can forcefully drain information out of his target's mind as well as control others with his will. While in a weakened state during the Great Darkness Saga, he controlled three billion Daxamites at once. He was able to force his mind into others' from across dimensional gaps. * Avatars: Darkseid can create duplicate bodies from portions of his energy that can function autonomously. They are significantly weaker than his real body but otherwise seem to retain his intellect and abilities. As all instances of Darkseid seen in lower-dimensional realms are infinitesimally small parts of Darkseid's true being, it stands to reason that Godhead Darkseid possesses all of the abilities demonstrated by them but to a much greater degree. Furthermore, he also possessed the Anti-Life Equation, using it to dominate much of Earth's populace in the moments before everything would be destroyed. * Omega Beams: A single use of the Omega Beams, used when Darkseid was dying and possessing the body of a cancer-ridden Dan Turpin, contained enough energy to destroy time itself. * Omega Sanction: The version of the Sanction used by the True Darkseid is infinitely more powerful and cruel than the Sanction demonstrated by his Pre-Flashpoint emanation. Rather than displacing its target through time it traps them in a never-ending succession of dark realities that inflict endless suffering upon the prisoner. * Possession: Darkseid can incarnate in the lower-dimensional mortal universe by possessing the body of a mortal. However, to truly incarnate he needs to corrupt the body of a good soul, which was why his first attempt at incarnating via a mob boss was a failure. * Anti-Life Equation: Using the Anti-Life Equation, Darkseid was able to assume total control over everyone who had been exposed to the broadcasted equation, effectively gaining three billion new bodies at once. The victims were completely subsumed by Darkseid's will, speaking with his voice and moving according to his desire.

Fought Vixen and harmed her whilst she was using her lesser animal powers, and harmed the (inconsistently durable) Hawkgirl with a kick. field_candidates.value: At least 8-C, likely High 8-C physically, possibly far higher, with at least 9-A energy beams, possibly far higher

*Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Flight *Energy Projection (Can fire energy blasts and beams) *With Skeets, Booster has access to Genius Intelligence, Information Analysis (Scanned a woman for life signs) and Air Manipulation (Blew smoke away with a fan)

At least Building Level, likely Large Building Level physically (Fought a sentient building, shifting it backward with his punches - later holding himself in place against the pull of a gravitational anomaly that sucked a building in even whilst closer to said anomaly than the building was. Defeated a building-sized robot, albeit offscreen. Effortlessly knocked doors off their hinges), possibly far higher (Managed to hold himself back from getting totally sucked in by the "mini black hole" after its pull had become powerful enough to seemingly bend several buildings), with at least Small Building Level energy beams (Destroyed the awning over a subway station and blasted away the resulting rubble. Damaged the exterior of a rock formation), possibly far higher (Possibly equal to or greater than the power of his physical strength) - Booster would not gain black hole strength scaling from holding back the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes.

*Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Flight *Energy Projection (Can fire energy blasts and beams) *With Skeets, Booster has access to Genius Intelligence, Information Analysis (Scanned a woman for life signs) and Air Manipulation (Blew smoke away with a fan)

At least Building Level, likely Large Building Level physically (Fought a sentient building, shifting it backward with his punches - later holding himself in place against the pull of a gravitational anomaly that sucked a building in even whilst closer to said anomaly than the building was. Defeated a building-sized robot, albeit offscreen. Effortlessly knocked doors off their hinges), possibly far higher (Managed to hold himself back from getting totally sucked in by the "mini black hole" after its pull had become powerful enough to seemingly bend several buildings), with at least Small Building Level energy beams (Destroyed the awning over a subway station and blasted away the resulting rubble. Damaged the exterior of a rock formation), possibly far higher (Possibly equal to or greater than the power of his physical strength) - Booster would not gain black hole strength scaling from holding back the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes.

At least Superhuman (Dodged a speeding train at close range), with Superhuman flight speed (Traversed a city pretty quickly)- Booster would not gain black hole speed scaling from reacting to being sucked in by the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes. Even normal humans are shown reacting to being sucked in by the anomaly, meaning clearly it isn't a real black hole which sucks things up faster than light.

At least Building Class, likely Large Building Class, possibly far higher (Should scale to his physical power as per Newton's Third Law. Survived attacks from a sentient building. Shrugged off being hit by a train and having a car fall on him) - Booster would not gain black hole durability scaling from holding back the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes.

Normal Human Weaknesses. Lacks actual confidence in himself, only putting up a facade of overconfidence. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 8 Category:Tier 9

At least Building Level, likely Large Building Level physically (Fought a sentient building, shifting it backward with his punches - later holding himself in place against the pull of a gravitational anomaly that sucked a building in even whilst closer to said anomaly than the building was. Defeated a building-sized robot, albeit offscreen. Effortlessly knocked doors off their hinges), possibly far higher (Managed to hold himself back from getting totally sucked in by the "mini black hole" after its pull had become powerful enough to seemingly bend several buildings), with at least Small Building Level energy beams (Destroyed the awning over a subway station and blasted away the resulting rubble. Damaged the exterior of a rock formation), possibly far higher (Possibly equal to or greater than the power of his physical strength) - Booster would not gain black hole strength scaling from holding back the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes.

At least Superhuman (Dodged a speeding train at close range), with Superhuman flight speed (Traversed a city pretty quickly)- Booster would not gain black hole speed scaling from reacting to being sucked in by the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes. Even normal humans are shown reacting to being sucked in by the anomaly, meaning clearly it isn't a real black hole which sucks things up faster than light.

At least Building Class, likely Large Building Class, possibly far higher (Should scale to his physical power as per Newton's Third Law. Survived attacks from a sentient building. Shrugged off being hit by a train and having a car fall on him) - Booster would not gain black hole durability scaling from holding back the gravitational anomaly, as clearly it isn't as powerful as a normal black hole (it is stated to be uncontrolled, yet it does not instantly swallow the planet, which an IRL black hole the size of a quarter would), and therefore he wouldn't scale to IRL Black Holes.

Normal Human Weaknesses. Lacks actual confidence in himself, only putting up a facade of overconfidence. Note: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Category:Goulden1998 Category:Tier 8 Category:Tier 9

With his standard equipment, he has: *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) *Flight (His drones can fly freely, and his ship is capable of MFTL+ flight) *Immortality (Type 1. If even a slight bit of his programming exists anywhere in the universe, he can and will return) *Inorganic Physiology (Type 2 - Is a computer program that animates itself through robotic drones) *Energy Projection (Fires energy beams through several means) *Data Manipulation/Information Manipulation/Information Analysis (Can implant himself into computers to alter the data within them as well as to absorb information) *Possession (Possessed Gear) *Preparation (Implanted his programming into Lex Luthor’s body in order to resurrect himself. Partnered with Darkseid to trap Superman during "Twilight." Made a false distress call to distract the Justice League. Formulated a plan to use The Flash to incapacitate the rest of the League during "A League of Their Own." Made sure to disable Lex Luthor’s missiles during "Stolen Memories." Sought out the Dark Heart drones in order to increase his strength during "Divided We Fall." Created an army of drones to combat the Justice League and assimilate the entire universe, as seen in "Twilight." Controlled Bruce Wayne in order to escape the planet during "Knight Time") *Hacking/Technopathy (Can overtake and overwhelm any computer system. Overtook the computers within the Watchtower, Lexcorp's computers, and Gear's backpack) *Electricity Manipulation (Electrocuted Superman) *Biological Manipulation (Cured Luthor's cancer and increased his physical strength, even as just a small fragment of himself existing within Luthor's body) *Forcefield Creation (Put a forcefield around his ship and around Superman) *Elasticity (Can extend his hands and fingers) *Paralysis Inducement (His ship in "Twilight" has a program that put a powerful energy restraint around Superman) With Optional Equipment, he has access to: *Mind Manipulation (with his thought-control disks and the Nanites that controlled Batman in "Knight Time") *Telekinesis (Lifted Superman with his speeder) *Gravity Manipulation (with this gadget) *Matter Manipulation (His beams can digitize solid objects) *Time Travel (The speeder he created in the 30th century can open a portal to the year 2979) *Portal Creation/BFR (The body he built in the 30th century created a portal to the sun with the push of a button) *Paralysis Inducement (In his "Stolen Memories" ship, used a restraint that temporarily held Superman in place)

Large Planet Level with his drones and strongest weaponry (Varies between at least 1.03 Ronnatons to at least 8.29 Ronnatons - Even his lesser bodies fire energy beams that can knock out Hawkgirl in a single hit and send The Flash flying across a room. One of his stronger bodies stopped a strike from Superman, though it's most probable that Superman wasn't using full strength. While inside Lex Luthor's body, he contended with the whole Justice League simultaneously, firing energy beams that took out several members. Used a beam that sent Superman flying. Some of his robots could temporarily hold off Superman. Even just a bunch of scrap metal from his bodies served to make someone as powerful as Darkseid slightly more powerful. At some point, one of his weapons broke Kalibak's arm. Made an explosion visible from space. His prerogative is to destroy planets, and he has done this several times over the years. See here for my reasoning as to why DCAU Superman is not Low Complex Multiversal)

His fastest weaponry and bodies are at least FTL (Scaling to 2.3c - Reacted to/tagged a furious Superman and, while in Lex Luthor's body, many members of the Justice League), with his ship being capable of Massively FTL+ flight speed (131,756c - In only about thirty years since Krypton's destruction, he has "roamed the universe")

Varies wildly (See Note), but his strongest bodies can take hits from a furious Superman (Large Planet Level), and one of his lesser bodies can remain intact after a swing from a bloodlusted Hawkgirl, which should come out to about Small Planet Level durability - at least equal, likely higher with Force Fields (Put a force field around his ship that even a furious Superman struggled to pry apart. Set up a force field around Superman that didn't even budge after attacks from Martian Manhunter and Hawkgirl)

Electricity shorts out his thought-control disks. Note: Brainiac's bodies seem to vary wildly in strength and durability - some can take hits from and somewhat scrap with an enraged Superman, whereas others are easily torn apart by Hawkgirl and even pierced by Batarangs - in one especially embarrassing instance, one of his bodies was pierced by shotgun bullets. Note 2: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Note 3: Shoutout to this respect thread for having video clips of feats/statements that I've been putting off screen recording. Supergenius (Considered the most intelligent being in the universe by SupermanAction Comics Annual 10 and Brainiac 5. Naturally a 12th Level Intellect, orders of magnitude higher than the 8th Level Intellects of Coluans, and uses technology to boost his intelligence even moreR.E.B.E.L.S. Vol 2 18 His brain is leagues stronger than machinery that can process information of over seven octodecillion beings Astronomically more intelligent than Lex Luthor and has outperformed him without trying. Has built machines capable of destroying one thousand years of history and eventually, all of time and space. His mind is so vast that Saturn Girl, one of the greatest telepaths in the universe, struggled to read it even when he was knocked out. Despite his truly vast intellect, he has been shown numerous times to be an at-best Average fighter, ironically relying on raw strength and brute-force, which has allowed him to be dominated by much more skillful fighters such as General Zod and Lex Luthor). Nigh-Omniscient as the God Machine (Processed all the information in the Post-Crisis multiverse, which was infinite)

See here for my reasoning as to why DCAU Superman is not Low Complex Multiversal)

His fastest weaponry and bodies are at least FTL (Scaling to 2.3c - Reacted to/tagged a furious Superman and, while in Lex Luthor's body, many members of the Justice League), with his ship being capable of Massively FTL+ flight speed (131,756c - In only about thirty years since Krypton's destruction, he has "roamed the universe")

Varies wildly (See Note), but his strongest bodies can take hits from a furious Superman (Large Planet Level), and one of his lesser bodies can remain intact after a swing from a bloodlusted Hawkgirl, which should come out to about Small Planet Level durability - at least equal, likely higher with Force Fields (Put a force field around his ship that even a furious Superman struggled to pry apart. 5-A with his drones and strongest weaponry, possibly far higher

With his standard equipment, he has: *Superhuman Physical Characteristics (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability) *Genius Intelligence (See Intelligence) *Flight (His drones can fly freely, and his ship is capable of MFTL+ flight) *Immortality (Type 1. If even a slight bit of his programming exists anywhere in the universe, he can and will return) *Inorganic Physiology (Type 2 - Is a computer program that animates itself through robotic drones) *Energy Projection (Fires energy beams through several means) *Data Manipulation/Information Manipulation/Information Analysis (Can implant himself into computers to alter the data within them as well as to absorb information) *Possession (Possessed Gear) *Preparation (Implanted his programming into Lex Luthor’s body in order to resurrect himself. Partnered with Darkseid to trap Superman during "Twilight." Made a false distress call to distract the Justice League. Formulated a plan to use The Flash to incapacitate the rest of the League during "A League of Their Own." Made sure to disable Lex Luthor’s missiles during "Stolen Memories." Sought out the Dark Heart drones in order to increase his strength during "Divided We Fall." Created an army of drones to combat the Justice League and assimilate the entire universe, as seen in "Twilight." Controlled Bruce Wayne in order to escape the planet during "Knight Time") *Hacking/Technopathy (Can overtake and overwhelm any computer system. Overtook the computers within the Watchtower, Lexcorp's computers, and Gear's backpack) *Electricity Manipulation (Electrocuted Superman) *Biological Manipulation (Cured Luthor's cancer and increased his physical strength, even as just a small fragment of himself existing within Luthor's body) *Forcefield Creation (Put a forcefield around his ship and around Superman) *Elasticity (Can extend his hands and fingers) *Paralysis Inducement (His ship in "Twilight" has a program that put a powerful energy restraint around Superman) With Optional Equipment, he has access to: *Mind Manipulation (with his thought-control disks and the Nanites that controlled Batman in "Knight Time") *Telekinesis (Lifted Superman with his speeder) *Gravity Manipulation (with this gadget) *Matter Manipulation (His beams can digitize solid objects) *Time Travel (The speeder he created in the 30th century can open a portal to the year 2979) *Portal Creation/BFR (The body he built in the 30th century created a portal to the sun with the push of a button) *Paralysis Inducement (In his "Stolen Memories" ship, used a restraint that temporarily held Superman in place)

Large Planet Level with his drones and strongest weaponry (Varies between at least 1.03 Ronnatons to at least 8.29 Ronnatons - Even his lesser bodies fire energy beams that can knock out Hawkgirl in a single hit and send The Flash flying across a room. One of his stronger bodies stopped a strike from Superman, though it's most probable that Superman wasn't using full strength. While inside Lex Luthor's body, he contended with the whole Justice League simultaneously, firing energy beams that took out several members. Used a beam that sent Superman flying. Some of his robots could temporarily hold off Superman. Even just a bunch of scrap metal from his bodies served to make someone as powerful as Darkseid slightly more powerful. At some point, one of his weapons broke Kalibak's arm. Made an explosion visible from space. His prerogative is to destroy planets, and he has done this several times over the years. See here for my reasoning as to why DCAU Superman is not Low Complex Multiversal)

His fastest weaponry and bodies are at least FTL (Scaling to 2.3c - Reacted to/tagged a furious Superman and, while in Lex Luthor's body, many members of the Justice League), with his ship being capable of Massively FTL+ flight speed (131,756c - In only about thirty years since Krypton's destruction, he has "roamed the universe")

Varies wildly (See Note), but his strongest bodies can take hits from a furious Superman (Large Planet Level), and one of his lesser bodies can remain intact after a swing from a bloodlusted Hawkgirl, which should come out to about Small Planet Level durability - at least equal, likely higher with Force Fields (Put a force field around his ship that even a furious Superman struggled to pry apart. Set up a force field around Superman that didn't even budge after attacks from Martian Manhunter and Hawkgirl)

Electricity shorts out his thought-control disks. Note: Brainiac's bodies seem to vary wildly in strength and durability - some can take hits from and somewhat scrap with an enraged Superman, whereas others are easily torn apart by Hawkgirl and even pierced by Batarangs - in one especially embarrassing instance, one of his bodies was pierced by shotgun bullets. Note 2: Bruce Timm has stated that the original DCAU tie-in comics are not canon, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo, I only consider those three comics canon. Note 3: Shoutout to this respect thread for having video clips of feats/statements that I've been putting off screen recording. Gifted. Nathaniel was a capable soldier, air force officer, and then later an intelligence officer and then a major. Using his power efficiently requires a certain understanding of the quantum field, as well as matter and energy. Has great battle experience, as well as leadership and strategic experience. Captain Atom travelled across the multiverse and gained a greater understanding of the universe/multiverse. As Monarch, he was easily able to deduce the plan of a Monitor, who wanted to be the sole winner of this expansive war.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 16 In addition, he entered a long war with the Monitors and created an army of superhumans to follow his every command. An adept leader of both the JLI, Extreme Justice, and a large team of heroes during the Invasion storyline,Invasion! Vol 1 2 as well as a multiversal army of supervillains.

None notable. | If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken. His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity.Captain Atom: Armageddon Vol 1 6 X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch.Extreme Justice Vol 1 8 As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. Notes: *This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics. *Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him. **If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards. **Some writers tend to ignore the character, continuity, and many powers of Captain Atom, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written. ***And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook. **In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor. *Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. The sliver of Void was merely creating a chain reaction inside of him to bring out his destructive power. *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses:

Gifted. Nathaniel was a capable soldier, air force officer, and then later an intelligence officer and then a major. Using his power efficiently requires a certain understanding of the quantum field, as well as matter and energy. Has great battle experience, as well as leadership and strategic experience. Captain Atom travelled across the multiverse and gained a greater understanding of the universe/multiverse. As Monarch, he was easily able to deduce the plan of a Monitor, who wanted to be the sole winner of this expansive war.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 16 In addition, he entered a long war with the Monitors and created an army of superhumans to follow his every command. An adept leader of both the JLI, Extreme Justice, and a large team of heroes during the Invasion storyline,Invasion! Vol 1 2 as well as a multiversal army of supervillains.

None notable. | If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken. His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity.Captain Atom: Armageddon Vol 1 6 X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch.Extreme Justice Vol 1 8 As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. Notes: *This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics. *Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him. **If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards. **Some writers tend to ignore the character, continuity, and many powers of Captain Atom, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written. ***And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook. **In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor. *Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. The sliver of Void was merely creating a chain reaction inside of him to bring out his destructive power. *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses:

Gifted. Nathaniel was a capable soldier, air force officer, and then later an intelligence officer and then a major. Using his power efficiently requires a certain understanding of the quantum field, as well as matter and energy. Has great battle experience, as well as leadership and strategic experience. Captain Atom travelled across the multiverse and gained a greater understanding of the universe/multiverse. As Monarch, he was easily able to deduce the plan of a Monitor, who wanted to be the sole winner of this expansive war.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 16 In addition, he entered a long war with the Monitors and created an army of superhumans to follow his every command. An adept leader of both the JLI, Extreme Justice, and a large team of heroes during the Invasion storyline,Invasion! Vol 1 2 as well as a multiversal army of supervillains.

None notable. | If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken. His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity.Captain Atom: Armageddon Vol 1 6 X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch.Extreme Justice Vol 1 8 As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. Notes: *This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics. *Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him. **If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards. **Some writers tend to ignore the character, continuity, and many powers of Captain Atom, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written. ***And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook. **In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor. *Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. The sliver of Void was merely creating a chain reaction inside of him to bring out his destructive power. *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses:

Nathaniel is able to coat himself with the metal, either partially or totally. Atom's symbiosis with the metal is such that even partially armored, he is able to access the Quantum Field. * Quantum Field Manipulation: Captain Atom's metal skin is tied into the Quantum Field, which enables him to absorb and manipulate incredible amounts of energy for a wide variety of applications. As a result, he is able to create an exact replica of Earth, complete with life, with a thought, as well as duplicates of Superman, Flash, Firestorm and even the Spectre with ease. His power is such, that he went even further, and by simply thinking of it, he was able to instantaneously create an entire universe out of nothing, and just as easily destroyed an entire universe, but he has never used this level of power again as a result of him mentally limiting himself. Captain Atom is also able to absorb potentially harmful energy into himself, but absorbing too much can overload him and send him hurtling through time. Captain Atom can fire and control energy of any form. He commonly manipulates his energy into forcefield bubbles, or explosive 'bombs', as well as simple blasts of kinetic force. While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. On more than one occasion, he has used his ability to manipulate all forms of energy to prevent a foe using their own powers, such as the Ray and Firestorm.

While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. Notes: *This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics. *Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him. **If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. When scaling characters from Captain Atom, please read over the context to understand how Captain Atom was acting and feeling beforehand, as well as afterwards. **Some writers tend to ignore the character, continuity, and many powers of Captain Atom, as well as his power levels, so if he fights someone, it does not mean they scale to his Galaxy level or higher level, especially since most of them boils down to how out of character Nathaniel is written. ***And if you do want to scale characters from him, please only scale those who battles him in a prolonged story arcs. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. Therefore, the main story takes precedence over a back-up issue, which was written to feel like a handbook. **In addition, the power levels of Captain Atom aren't that different than his usual self. In this form, he doesn't hold back at all since he is a villain and utilises everything he has in his arsenal.Countdown to Final Crisis Vol 1 8 He has many statements and scaling in his usual form which doesn't contradict any potential higher showings with the Monarch armor. *Captain Atom was not empowered when the sliver of Void took residence within him during Captain Atom: Armageddon story arc. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. His power is such, that he went even further, and by simply thinking of it, he was able to instantaneously create an entire universe out of nothing, and just as easily destroyed an entire universe, but he has never used this level of power again as a result of him mentally limiting himself. Captain Atom is also able to absorb potentially harmful energy into himself, but absorbing too much can overload him and send him hurtling through time. Captain Atom can fire and control energy of any form. He commonly manipulates his energy into forcefield bubbles, or explosive 'bombs', as well as simple blasts of kinetic force. While he usually aims with his hands, he is able to emit energy from any point on his body. Several times he has "detonated", releasing a massive amount of energy at once, destroying objects within an certain radius. On more than one occasion, he has used his ability to manipulate all forms of energy to prevent a foe using their own powers, such as the Ray and Firestorm.

Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. Notes: *This file only covers his Post-Crisis incarnation and not the New 52 or the original from Charlton Comics. *Captain Atom can perform at various levels of powers since he has complete control over his destructive capabilities. In addition, his emotional and mental state also plays a large role in it. To avoid his potential God Complex or evil self from taking control, he tries to hold back as much as possible and all of his stats tend to go down with him. **If possible, please avoid scaling characters from Captain Atom, sans Superboy-Prime. One or two page battles are often to be ignored due to how his character is written sometimes. *Monarch Armor slightly augments his powers according to a back-up story, however, the main story arc contradicted the said enhancements. If the laws of nature are tampered with, his powers weaken.His eyes aren't as durable as the rest of his body. If his skin is breached, he can cause a powerful explosion of quantum force. Two quantum field manipulators can cancel out each other's powers. Often, he tries to hold back his power levels due to potential God Complex and fears he is losing his humanity. X-Ionized weapons can cut his skin. If Captain Atom absorbs too much energy at once, he will be sent hurtling through time. Depending on the type of energy absorbed, he either goes forward or backwards. Sometimes after he goes nuclear, it takes up to 24 hours for his powers to return. Captain Atom also fears turning into his dark side known as Monarch. As Monarch, he was very ruthless and overconfident. His Monarch armor is not as sturdy as his Captain Atom shell. If his Armor gets breached, it can accidentally release enough energy to destroy an entire Universal space-time continuum. Notable Attacks/Techniques *Hold back: Captain Atom almost always holds back for various reasons. It can be his mental state, his emotional state, or some other inner conflict he is going through. In addition, he fears his dark side taking over and getting the better of him. Therefore, his power varies greatly and rarely ever go all out. In Captain Atom Vol.2 54 - 57 he stopped holding back momentarily, which led to him creating and destroying a universe over and over again with but a mere thought. As Monarch, he had no such mental weakness and always fought at his full strength. *Talk first: Captain Atom is a man with a lot of trauma, and often, he would rather talk than go all out and fight someone. He is a kind man and is willing to hear them out first rather than hurt them - when possible, of course. And even if he attacks, he rarely ever attack first. As Monarch, he likes to emotionally hurt his opponents and hold the higher ground intellectually before unleashing his power against them. *Energy over matter: Captain Atom's primary method of attack is energy manipulation. He has more control over its output compared to his other destructive abilities. Even when battling in melee combat, he prefers to employ energy in any way he can. *BFR: As Monarch, sometimes he would simply remove his enemies from the battlefield rather than waste time on them. *Quantum Field: By manipulating the Quantum Field, Captain Atom is able to control time, space, energy, and matter at will. His energy absorption is potent enough to overcome foes significantly more powerful than himself, such as Nekron. *Big Bang: Captain Atom is also able to control incredible amounts of energy, being able to catalyze another Big Bang if he so wished. ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: Category:Z's Universe Category:Tier 2

Outerverse level (She nearly destroyed the Sphere of the Gods, which exists outside the confines of space and time and is classified as 1-A in power scale. In the comics, Circe hinted that she could have accomplished this feat long ago had she chosen to do so. Hecate also fought against Rama Kushna in Nanda Parbat (Rama's place of power), wielding only one-fifth of her total power. This is very impressive, considering the fact that Rama Kushna's near-death jeopardized the very fabric of all universes, categorizing her at least at Low 1-C. Furthermore, Hecate displayed her overwhelming might by swiftly eliminating all Olympian Gods within moments, as depicted in the "Dark Multiverse: War of the Gods" comic. Hecate draws her powers directly from the Source (The Presence), and she is intricately connected to the Collective Unconscious, which is also recognized as 1-A.

Outerverse level

Like many immensely powerful beings, Hecate finds herself constrained by a specific set of rules and limitations. A notable instance of this occurred when she was ensnared and tormented by human magicians who cunningly wielded her own magic against her. This scenario echoes the plight of other formidable entities, such as the Dream of the Endless, who can also be bound under certain precise conditions.

Gifted (A seasoned actor who proclaims himself as one of the greatest of all time with decades of cinema experience and shows it with his disguises of various heroes, villains and normal citizens that has shown to be able to fool people such as Wonder Woman, Batgirl and Batman briefly. Master manipulator, influencing even the very people that went to recruit him in the first place as seen by his time in the Mud Pack and stated to be a crafty criminal tactician as well)

Extreme cold or heat is good at turning his body's fluidity into solid, allowing him to be temporarily subduedGotham City Sirens #24. Heat up to 1,000 degrees Celsius to his clay core undermines his basic cellular structure. Sufficiently powerful sonics is able to disrupt his metabolismArkham Reborn #3. Water can melt down his body structureDC Comics Presents: Batman. People that he has absorbed is able to be removed through certain poisonous gases. Crowbars are able to trigger PTSD within him, making him blind with rageGotham City Sirens #20.
